name: How long does a typical door replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door replacement project varies depending on the type of door and complexity of the installation. A standard entry door replacement can often be completed in one day. However, projects involving custom-sized doors, structural modifications, or multiple doors might take several days. We provide a clear timeline during the initial consultation, factoring in potential unforeseen issues like discovering rot in the door frame, which can extend the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most standard door replacements can be done in a day, but custom or complex projects may take longer.
